static_rtl_seam_audit.active_state_priority: The nonzero launch writes active=1/count/contexts; a successful final response clears active only when launch_accept is false, so the new active group is not overwritten.
static_rtl_seam_audit.context_state_priority: Old active contexts are necessarily launched while every legal next context is allocated and not launched, proving disjointness. The final response frees only old contexts; launch marks only new contexts launched. A same-edge command allocates an old-state free context and cannot alias either set.
static_rtl_seam_audit.metadata_state: A legal final response is asserted only for the last metadata entry, has no concurrent old-group request, and drains metadata occupancy from one to zero before the next group can issue.
static_rtl_seam_audit.completion_and_credit: The same edge pushes exactly the old group K and may pop one output. Complete occupancy conserves push minus pop and the final response is blocked unless old-K credit, including same-edge pop credit, is available.
static_rtl_seam_audit.zero_source_exclusion: A legal all-zero next union is explicitly denied the seam because it would require a second completion batch/write contract. It waits until the old group retires.
legal_concurrency_closed: final response plus next nonzero launch
final response plus next nonzero launch plus output pop
same-edge command allocation is statically preserved
remaining_static_performance_bubbles: all-zero next groups cannot use the seam
command allocation cannot look ahead through contexts freed by the final response
a just-accepted command cannot be launched on the same edge

tamper_audit.interpretation: The exact currently reviewed bytes are independently root-hash bound and correct. The producer additive validator preserves the original failure semantics, but it neither fixes the allowed entry path set nor validates its own additive claim boundary, additive receipt or RUN_COMPLETE. Therefore a linked-resigned wrapper can widen claims or substitute unrelated entry paths while the validator still passes.

P1.finding: The producer additive validator does not validate its additive contract claim boundary, does not consume the additive receipt or RUN_COMPLETE, and accepts arbitrary linked-resigned entry paths as long as those new paths hash to their newly declared values. A dynamic linked-resign attack widened system/PPA claims and substituted fake ledger/replay/r1-receipt entry paths while the producer validator still returned PASS.
P1.impact: The current release bytes are correct only because this independent review pins their root hashes; the producer release chain by itself is not fail-closed against wrapper relabelling or linked resigning.
P1.minimal_fix: Create an additive r3 validator with an immutable expected contract SHA, an exact required entry path set, semantic equality between entries and paths, and strict validation of additive receipt, RUN_COMPLETE, output manifest and every false claim boolean; add linked-resign tamper tests.

P1.finding: Full S00 reaches metadata occupancy only one and records no request/response/output stall, no complete-full or complete13-pop-push4 event, no same-edge command seam, and no bad/mismatched/overflow final-response class.
P1.impact: The legal trace strongly exercises ordinary seams but does not dynamically close the exact high-pressure and negative cases most likely to expose credit, same-address FIFO or fault-gating bugs.
P1.minimal_fix: Run a dedicated Synopsys VCS seam-pressure suite that fills completion to sixteen, gates K4 final credit, exercises full same-address pop/push, zero-next credit waits, command-plus-launch-plus-output, and proves bad/mismatched/overflow final responses never open the seam.

P1.finding: The measured advantage is 1.083064x, or 7.6693% cycle reduction, against M57 on one frozen S00 offline temporal-engine schedule. M66 is only a two-condition lookahead derivative of M54 and does not establish a two-to-three-times accelerator advantage.
P1.impact: This is a worthwhile control optimization but is not by itself a competitive Prosperity/Phi-class system-performance or novelty headline.
P1.minimal_fix: Compose M66 with orthogonal source-work, memory-traffic and operator-overlap improvements, then replay all ten samples and report end-to-end cycles against equal-resource Fixed, RQTB, Prosperity and Phi-like baselines.

P1.finding: There is no M66-specific DC/STA/Formality, address-timed SRAM/DRAM model, macro-aware area, SAIF/PTPX energy, full-network cycle composition, accuracy audit or equal-resource baseline table.
P1.impact: The RTL-cycle result cannot yet support DATE PPA, energy-efficiency, FPS, accuracy or full-accelerator claims.
P1.minimal_fix: Close exact-SHA M54-vs-M66 same-resource DC/STA/Formality, workload-linked SAIF/PTPX, SRAM macro and traffic accounting, all10/full-network cycles, accuracy and equal-resource baseline normalization.

P2.finding: Zero-union groups and contexts freed on the final edge cannot be consumed by the current lookahead, leaving additional boundary bubbles and preventing command dynamic cover in the serial trace driver.
P2.minimal_fix: Add a formally specified dual-completion or deferred-zero path and a safe final-free-to-command allocator bypass, each with exact credit and write-port accounting.

P2.finding: Only H67 S00 and an offline target schedule are sealed; sequence, density and scheduler sensitivity are unknown.
P2.minimal_fix: Replay S00 through S09, Local5 and event-density/equal-rate strata with a realizable online scheduler and publish per-sample distributions.

P2.finding: The compact ledger independently replays handshake tags and occupancy, but full 96-lane accumulator values are evidenced by the VCS procedural scoreboard and zero mismatch rather than an independently replayable per-output value hash.
P2.minimal_fix: Seal a compact per-output tag/count/accumulator digest ledger and compare it against an independent arithmetic oracle.
